resolve: [ -n "$MIMIR_WORK_ITEM_JSON" ] && { printf %s "$MIMIR_WORK_ITEM_JSON"; exit 0; }; export CLICOLOR_FORCE=0 NO_COLOR=1; n=$(printf %s "$FACTORY_INPUT" | tr "\n" " " | sed -e "s|^[[:space:]]*||" -e "s|[[:space:]]*$||" | sed -n -e "s|^#\{0,1\}\([0-9][0-9]*\)$|\1|p" -e "s|^https://github.com/jasoncarreira/mimir/issues/\([0-9][0-9]*\)$|\1|p"); [ -n "$n" ] || exit 0; kind=$(gh api "repos/jasoncarreira/mimir/issues/$n" --jq 'if .pull_request then "pr" else "issue" end') || exit 1; [ "$kind" = "issue" ] || { printf 'reference %s is not an issue (%s)\n' "$n" "$kind" >&2; exit 1; }; gh issue view "$n" --repo jasoncarreira/mimir --json number,title,body,url,state,labels,assignees --jq '{run_id:(.number|tostring)} + .'
